name: verification_health
description: Execute Java, Go, Python, Ruby, Node, npm, and npx probes in inherited and isolated environments on the separately deployed verification worker.

data.description: No fields are read from task input; the worker inspects only process environment (WORKER_MODULES) and host runtime state.

healthy.description: True only when every required runtime family is available in both environments, idle-sleep inhibition is active, lease renewal is enabled, and all registered workers are guarded.

optionalFamilies.description: Runtime families that are allowed to be unavailable without failing overall health.

families.description: Per-runtime-family availability report, keyed by family name (e.g. java, go, python, ruby, node).

requiredTools.description: Tool binaries this family depends on.

inheritedAvailable.description: True when every required tool is available in the inherited (non-isolated) environment.

isolatedAvailable.description: True when every required tool is available in the isolated environment.

available.description: True when the family is available in both environments.

required.description: False when this family is in optionalFamilies and its absence does not fail overall health.

executionDeadlinePolicy.description: Fixed policy string describing how long verification runs are allowed to execute.

leaseRenewalEnabled.description: Whether CONDUCTOR_WORKER_ALL_LEASE_EXTEND_ENABLED is set truthy in the process environment.

idleSleepInhibitionActive.description: Whether the host's idle-sleep inhibition mechanism is currently active.

idleSleepInhibitionMechanism.description: The mechanism used to inhibit idle sleep, e.g. 'caffeinate -i' on macOS or 'not-required' elsewhere.

typescriptCompilerPolicy.description: Fixed policy string describing how the TypeScript compiler is invoked.

inheritedCapabilities.description: Per-tool availability/version evidence gathered in the inherited (non-isolated) environment.

isolatedCapabilities.description: Per-tool availability/version evidence gathered in the isolated environment.

workerGuards.description: Inventory of every worker registered in this process and whether it carries the lease-renewal and idle-sleep guards.

healthy.description: True when at least one worker is registered and every registered worker is guarded.

registeredWorkers.description: Count of registered (task, domain) worker entries.

guardedWorkers.description: Count of registered workers that have both lease renewal and idle-sleep inhibition enabled.

task.description: Task definition name this worker polls.

domain.description: Task domain, or empty string when unset.

leaseRenewal.description: Whether this worker has lease-extend enabled.

idleSleepInhibition.description: Whether this worker's function is decorated with idle-sleep inhibition.

threadCount.description: Configured concurrent poll thread count for this worker.

guarded.description: True when both leaseRenewal and idleSleepInhibition are true.

workerRole.description: Fixed role label identifying this worker process.

isolatedWorker.description: True when 'verification' appears in the WORKER_MODULES environment variable, i.e. this process is a dedicated verification worker.

modules.description: Sorted set of worker modules declared via WORKER_MODULES.
